name: Xchangely Payment Gateway for WooCommerce
author: xchangely

sections.description:
Xchangely Payment Gateway for WooCommerce enables your store to securely process payments via credit cards through the Xchangely platform.

Xchangely’s payment gateway is the most versatile solution available to Indian exporters to collect card payments from 180+ countries. Our payment gateway comes with bank-grade security, supported by globally renowned partners, and built specifically for cross-border transactions.

With our payment gateway, merchants can leverage:
* Card payments from 180+ countries.
* 70+ local digital wallets tailored to the buyer’s location.
* Custom payment links that are intuitive and easy for customers.
* Transaction success rates exceeding 90%.
* Transaction processing costs that are 50% lower than incumbent solutions.
* Transparent FX rates.
* Ongoing screening and fraud monitoring for secure transactions.
* Same day or T+1 settlements.
* Comprehensive dashboard with real-time status updates.

Key Features:

  • On activation, the plugin prompts the store owner to enter their business details.
  • Submitted details are securely sent to Xchangely for verification.
  • After approval by Xchangely, the plugin author will provide API keys.
  • Once the keys are entered in WooCommerce > Payments, a new “Xchangely” payment method becomes available at checkout.
  • Customers can securely enter their card details during checkout.
  • Successful payments automatically generate WooCommerce orders.

License

This plugin is free software; you can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by the Free Software Foundation, version 2 or later.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services:

  1. Tazapay

    • Purpose: Used to initiate and manage payment transactions.
    • Data Sent: Customer name, email, country, billing/shipping address, transaction amount, reference ID, and callback URLs.
    • When: Data is sent when a user initiates a payment at checkout.
    • Endpoints Used:
      • https://service-sandbox.tazapay.com/v3/payin
      • https://service.tazapay.com
    • Terms of Service: https://www.tazapay.com/terms-of-service
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.tazapay.com/privacy-policy

  2. Xchangely API

    • Purpose: Used to register and retrieve merchant business/user details.
    • Data Sent: Business information, user profile data, UUIDs.
    • When: During plugin activation and API configuration.
    • Endpoints Used:
      • https://qa.xchangely.com/register-business
      • https://qa.xchangely.com/user-details
      • https://qa.xchangely.com/business-details
    • Terms of Service: https://www.xchangely.com/terms (Update with actual link if different)
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.xchangely.com/privacy (Update with actual link if different)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wp-xchangely directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. On activation, complete the popup registration form with your business details.
  4. Wait for Xchangely’s approval and API keys.
  5. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments and enter your API keys in the “Xchangely” payment gateway section.
  6. Save changes.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support recurring payments?

Currently, Xchangely Payment Gateway for WooCommerce supports one-time credit card payments only.

Is the payment form PCI compliant?

Yes, all card details are handled securely following Xchangely’s PCI-DSS compliant systems.

Can I use this plugin in any country?

Please check Xchangely’s website for the list of supported countries.
